answer: Keeping 157 aliases alive thus means 157 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the voyage quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the violet log publishes the live set and the meadow audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 206 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
